headline: From TAB Massage & Fitness to TAB Human Performance Center
metaDescription: How TAB Massage & Fitness, serving Brighton and Howell since 2008, grew into TAB Human Performance Center.
paragraphs: TAB began in December 2008 as TAB Massage & Fitness in the Brighton and Howell area, with an approach that already brought massage, training and coaching together.

Over the years we have experienced both growth and shrinkage. We have adapted to the ever changing landscape of what holistic health and wellness is and has become. Throughout this journey we have learned a great deal and garnered an incredible amount of experience. It is now time to bring the brand we created in 2008 into the modern era of health and wellness.


TAB Human Performance Center - the new name that reflects what TAB has grown into: an integrated center helping people build strength, resilience, adaptability and capacity for real life, across five pillars: Massage & Bodywork, Functional Strength, Women’s Wellness, Integrated Nutrition and Holistic Life Coaching.

We are committed more than ever to providing our clients with the best possible care, guidance, information, and coaching. We are successful because you are successful. To all of our existing clients, and to our new one, welcome to TAB Human Performance
